question: 11over5 of a number A is 22% of a number B. The number B is equal to 2.5% of a third number C. If the value of C is 5500, then the sum of 80% of A and 40% of B is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

(11/5) × A = (22/100) × B

⇒ A = B/10

⇒ A/B = 1/10

Also, B = (2.5/100) × C

⇒ B = C/40 [∵ 2.5% = 1/40]

⇒ B/C = 1/40

⇒ B/C = 10/400 [∵ A/B = 1/10]

Here, 400 units = 5500

⇒ 1 unit = 5500/400 = 55/4

The sum of 80% of A and 40% of B = [(4/5) × (55/4)] + [(2/5) × (550/4)] [∵ 80% = 4/5 and 40% = 2/5]

= 11 + 55

= 66

∴ The sum of 80% of A and 40% of B is 66

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

11/5 of a number A is 22% of a number B

The number B is equal to 2.5% of a third number C

The value of C = 5500

**Calculation:**

B = (2.5/100) × C

⇒ B = (2.5/100) × 5500

⇒ B = 137.5

Also, (11/5) × A = (22/100) × B

⇒ (11/5) × A = (22/100) × 137.5

⇒ A = (22/100) × (1375/10) × (5/11)

⇒ A = 13.75

Then, the sum of 80% of A and 40% of B = [13.75 × (80/100)] + [137.5 × (40/100)]

= 11 + 55

= 66

**∴ The sum of 80% of A and 40% of B is 66**
